name: Fighting Cock Islet
kicker: The pair you see from the boat
summary: You look at two separated rocks from the boat. The port calls Hòn Trống Mái, also Gà Chọi, the symbol of Hạ Long tourism. A landing was not described. Many Cát Bà crossing boats pass it and skip the other stops. The time is inside the route, not a walk ashore.
timeNeeded: From the deck, inside the route
getThere: Route 1 boat, or a crossing boat toward Cat Ba
heroCaption: The separated rocks in the bay

notice.title: Look from the deck
notice.body: The port does not describe a landing. Many crossing boats toward Cát Bà pass this pair and skip the other stops.

body: The rocks are the pair with a gap between them. You see them from the water, on route 1 or on a crossing boat. The port calls them the symbol of Hạ Long tourism. Come in daylight so the gap reads.
The 9 June 2024 Cát Bà article says many boats pass Hòn Trống Mái and skip the other stops. A minute beside the rocks was not printed. Check on arrival. The fee is the route, not a separate ticket.

figures.caption: The pair from the water
figures.alt: The Fighting Cock rocks, also called the Kissing Rocks, in Ha Long Bay

gettingThere: From the route-1 boat out of Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long, or from a crossing boat. The Cát Bà shortcut article says the water crossing is about 7 km. A minute beside these rocks was not printed.

legs.heading: From the Ha Long port
legs.body: Inside route 1, which is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. The rocks are what you pass. The port does not say the boat stops.

legs.heading: On a Cat Ba crossing
legs.body: Many crossing boats pass the pair and skip the other stops. The shortcut is about 7 km and about 200,000 đồng a guest for two ways on the 9 June 2024 article. A minute was not printed.

hours: Check on arrival. Daylight, so the gap between the rocks reads.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Confirm the sailing the day you go.
admissionNote: Inside the route. Route 1 on the 15 March 2024 page is 440,000–460,000 đồng. A crossing toward Cát Bà is a different fare: about 200,000 đồng a guest for two ways on the shortcut, and the Tuần Châu–Gia Luận ferry with no fare printed. Both routes stay.
